name: Physicswallah Ltd
basis: Consolidated (Screener; FY21 ten-month standalone column dropped in PWL.patch.js)

sources.what: Annual report FY26 (AGM notice letter dated 1-Sep-2026)
Q4FY26 call summary (no transcript filed; audio only)

segments.name: Online
segments.what: Live and recorded courses on the PW app and website (JEE, NEET, Foundation, UPSC, CA, state boards, K-12 tuition 'Curious Jr', vernacular, skills), test series, PW Books, Pi, PW Talk. Sold at ~₹4,000 a year (ACPU ₹4,104 in FY26); 4.87 mn paying users in FY26.

segments.name: Offline
segments.what: 353 centres at Mar-26 (366 at Jun-26) in 178 Indian cities and 6 in the UAE: Vidyapeeth (classroom; ~70% of offline revenue), Pathshala (two-teacher hybrid), other centres (UPSC, CA, defence, government exams) and the subsidiaries Xylem (Kerala), Utkarsh Classes (Rajasthan government exams) and Knowledge Planet (UAE). 0.47 mn students, ARPU ₹36,625 in FY26.

segments.name: Others
segments.what: YouTube advertising, content licensing, hardware, FinZ student financing (being exited, Aug-2026), Key Lifestyle, PW Foundation.

q1fy27.neet: NTA cancelled the 3-May-2026 NEET-UG exam on 12-May-2026 and re-held it on 21-Jun-2026; results came on 16-Jul-2026, a month later than in 2025. Online NEET collections fell 28% in Q1; from 1-Jul to 13-Aug online collections grew 51%. Management: offline growth would have been 20-25% without the shift.

guidanceAndCall.what: FY27 revenue growth ~30% and pre-IndAS EBITDA 'improvement' of 100% (doubling from ₹300 cr) reiterated after Q1; FY27 PAT positive
guidanceAndCall.src: Q1FY27 call (Prateek Boob); JM Financial 14-Aug-2026; Q4FY26 call summary

guidanceAndCall.what: Offline: near break-even (pre-IndAS) for FY27; steady-state centre margin 13-15%, which the 2023-24 centres already earn (Kota excepted); new centres profitable within ~24 months
Online pre-IndAS margin ~27% in FY26 and to improve in FY27; Curious Jr to break even in FY27
Centre expansion slowed and 'opportunistic'; new-centre plans to be decided over the next two quarters (Feb-2026 plan was ~70 centres in FY27 for ~₹200 cr)
Capital allocation: new online content and categories, AI, selective online-focused acquisitions; exiting lending (FinZ loan book to an RBI-registered partner; term sheet signed)

accounting.revenue: Fees collected upfront and recognised over the batch, so revenue lags cash: ~79% of FY26 collections came in Mar-Sep; contract liabilities ₹1,149 cr at Mar-26 (₹864 cr at Mar-25).
accounting.ebitdaDefinitions: The company publishes four EBITDA figures: EBITDA (after other income, exceptional items and ESOP: ₹549 cr FY26), Adjusted EBITDA (before ESOP and exceptional items, incl. other income: ₹784 cr), Pre-IndAS EBITDA (after rent, before other income: ₹300 cr) and segment EBITDA. Our model EBITDA follows Screener: revenue less operating costs incl. ESOP and lease-free (Ind AS 116): ₹370 cr in FY26.
accounting.leases: Lease liabilities ₹1,041.6 cr at Mar-26; lease payments ₹252 cr in FY26 (interest ~₹85 cr).
accounting.exceptional: FY26: ₹40 cr exceptional (goodwill impairment of Bothra and Etoos, fair-value loss) + ₹24 cr one-time (IPO expenses, labour codes). Q1FY27: ₹44 cr fair-value charge on the Sarrthi IAS stake purchase.
accounting.redemptionLiability: Put options to buy out minority holders of acquired companies (iNeuron, Xylem, Utkarsh, Sarrthi) carried as a redemption liability (other financial liabilities ₹463 cr at Mar-26, of which the redemption liability is the larger part) through an NCI reserve.
accounting.contingent: Contingent liabilities only ₹23 cr (direct tax) at Mar-26; capital commitments ₹82 cr.
accounting.tax: FY26 tax ₹34 cr on PBT ₹10 cr (loss-making subsidiaries; DTA reversal on loss use). Unabsorbed losses with DTA only ₹51 cr.
